cover.bottom: FROM MAINE TO VIRGINIA IN ITS PATH

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons nor'easter coastal flooding New Jersey
photo.prompt: large waves and floodwater covering a coastal street during a nor'easter on the U.S. East Coast

slides.headline: Nor’easter puts Maine to Virginia in its path
slides.body: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia are in the path of the powerful storm.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons East Coast nor'easter storm waves
photo.prompt: dark storm clouds over rough Atlantic surf along the U.S. East Coast

slides.headline: That includes emergencies in New York and New Jersey
slides.body: New York and New Jersey declared emergencies as the storm brings coastal flooding, heavy rain and wind.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons New York City storm rain flooding
photo.prompt: rain and standing water on a New York City street during a coastal storm

slides.headline: And heavy snow and high winds are hitting the Northeast
slides.body: The storm has brought heavy snow and high winds to parts of the Northeast and snarled travel in New York City.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons New York City heavy snow storm
photo.prompt: snow-covered New York City street with traffic moving slowly during a winter storm

slides.headline: That started as a bombogenesis snowstorm
slides.body: The system rapidly strengthened off the East Coast before pushing snow, wind and coastal flooding into the region.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons satellite nor'easter cyclone East Coast
photo.prompt: satellite-style view of a large winter cyclone off the U.S. East Coast

slides.headline: Which has left at least 3 dead at the Jersey Shore
slides.body: At least 3 people have died as the dayslong nor’easter brings a final surge of coastal flooding to the Jersey Shore.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Jersey Shore coastal flooding storm
photo.prompt: flooded street near beach homes on the Jersey Shore during a nor'easter

slides.headline: So officials warn of outages, damage and flight cuts
slides.body: New York City faces flooding, power outages and damage Sunday, while airports report hundreds of canceled flights.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons LaGuardia Airport winter storm delays
photo.prompt: airport departure board with canceled flights during a winter storm

slides.credit: Photo: Miami Beach Casino Co. / Public domain

caption:
A nor’easter is hitting the East Coast, with emergencies in New York and New Jersey and tens of millions from Maine to Virginia in its path.
Do you have family or travel plans anywhere in the storm zone?
